dedupe_keys.name: kapsarc data portal energy and economic datasets saudi arabia gulf and international with api

description: The KAPSARC Data Portal of the King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center offers open access to energy and economic data for researchers, with geospatial data, data stories and an API; its catalogue listed 1,318 datasets on 2026-09-26. Two datasets reached through a search for substations illustrate its content: Saudi transmission substations by year for 2007 to 2019, with the number of substations and transformers and transformer capacity in MVA from the former Electricity and Cogeneration Regulatory Authority (now the Water and Electricity Regulatory Authority), discontinued after 2019; and China's monthly incremental AC substation capacity by voltage class from 1000 kV down to 220 kV for 2007 to 2017, sourced from Power Knowledge Thinker under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Datasets are free to browse and export; licences are set per dataset and some state none. Caveats: many tables are republished from other sources and some are discontinued, so the original source should be checked. Simulation uses are national capacity statistics for capacity planning in Gulf and Asian power systems. Related records: data-owid-energy-dataset gives country energy series.
licence: varies by dataset (for example CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, or none stated)
